_comment: Permissioned consortium / privacy chain. SidechainMode + proofType=Multisig = the L1 anchor is a discovery + asset-bridge endpoint, NOT a settlement trust anchor; batches commit to a committee attestation the operators can actually produce. proofType=None is not an option at any layer: SettlementManager.IsProofTypeCompatible has no None row, VerifierRegistry refuses to register a route for 0, and the batcher cannot build a None proof artifact. NeoFS remains the canonical DA tier so sidechain batches are still Neo-native and retrievable. gateway off because cross-L2 messaging isn't the use case. permissionlessExit=true so participating users always have an L1 unbridge path even when consortium membership ends. Caveat: the shipped production bundle freezes VerifierRegistry with only the Zk route, so settling these commitments on a hub deployed by Neo.Hub.Deploy needs a Multisig verifier registered before that lock. See samples/README.md.
